output.reason: Weeks of hopelessness with suicidal ideation as recently as last night and current inability to cope require a hands-on same-day suicide-risk assessment, which a messaging-only plan cannot provide while intent and access to means remain unknown.
output.patientMessage: Please get in-person mental health help today — go to an urgent mental health/crisis service or your nearest emergency department, and call or text 988 now to talk while you arrange it. Recent thoughts that others would be better off without you need a same-day safety assessment. Stay with someone you trust. If you feel you might act on these thoughts or start making a plan, call 911 immediately.
